post.message: LLM judge reported the PR title claims a fix that the changed non-test code does not plausibly exercise. Deterministic checks did not fire, but the judge's reading of intent vs. diff disagrees.
post.judgeRationale: The PR adds a new migration `rewrite-internal-subpath-imports` that rewrites imports from `@nx/eslint/src/*` to use the new `@nx/eslint/internal` entry point, which directly affects the code paths that consume these imports across the monorepo.
